summary: Grupo Televisa, S.A.B. filed a 6-K reporting the issuance of zero-coupon mandatory convertible debentures totaling MXN 6,917,800,007.42. The debentures will mandatorily convert into Series A, B, D, L shares and/or CPOs on the one-year anniversary, subject to regulatory approvals, representing 19.48% of the company's capital stock with a one-year lock-up. The subscription price was based on the 30-day VWAP of CPOs. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including potential telecom sector transactions or debt prepayment. Fintech Latam S.à r.l. subscribed and will hold 22.3% post-conversion, with passive investment status. The issuance is a capital return via mandatory convertible debt. Watch for conversion and regulatory clearance.
